formulas.general: revenue=sum(component_revenue); normal_op=revenue*normal_operating_margin OR revenue*gross_margin-normal_opex; pretax=normal_op+normal_net_interest; tax=max(pretax,0)*normal_tax_rate; parent=pretax-tax; EPS=parent/diluted_shares
formulas.advantest: AI_multiplier=(macro_AI_capex/1000)^elasticity; nonAI=(1+nonAI_CAGR)^n; TAM=base_TAM*(AI_weight*AI_multiplier*(1+complexity_CAGR)^n+(1-AI_weight)*nonAI)*cycle; base_SoC_TAM=11bnUSD, base_memory_TAM=2.75bnUSD; each revenue=TAM*share*USDJPY; add ancillary revenue
formulas.asml: EUV_demand=16.82*(0.75*(macro/1000)^elasticity*(1+EUV_intensity)^n+0.25*(1+nonAI)^n)*cycle; EUV_capacity=16.82*1.3^min(n,2)*1.15^max(n-2,0)*1.03^n; delivered_EUV_TAM=min(demand,capacity); DUV_TAM=(14.4/0.84)*(0.4*(macro/1000)^elasticity*(1+DUV_intensity)^n+0.6*(1+nonAI)^n)*cycle; DUV_rev=DUV_TAM*share; add service=12.238*(1+service_CAGR)^n and metro=0.99*(1+metro_CAGR)^n; n=year-2026
